claims.claim: ELECTRA jointly trains a masked-language-model generator and replaced-token discriminator.
claims.verification_note: Generator outputs sampled replacements, not argmax-only.

claims.claim: RTD labels correspond to whether sampled token ID differs from original input token, even when that position was previously selected for generator masking.
claims.verification_note: Official code compares sampled token IDs to original IDs.

claims.claim: ELECTRA discriminator predicts labels at each nonpadding token while generator MLM targets selected token positions.
claims.verification_note: Clarifies 'all positions' means effective nonpadding tokens.

claims.claim: Official ELECTRA default loss weights are generator=1.0 and discriminator=50.0.
claims.verification_note: Weights are code implementation defaults, not universal loss-scale constants.

claims.claim: ELECTRA trains with sampled discrete replacements and does not use standard GAN adversarial gradient propagation through samples.
claims.verification_note: Separates generator MLM and discriminator RTD objectives.

claims.claim: ELECTRA experiments demonstrate greater sample efficiency compared with MLM baselines under specified compute budgets.
claims.verification_note: No invented fixed multiplier or universal improvement is claimed.

claims.claim: At fine-tuning, the discriminator encoder is the retained pretrained model.
claims.verification_note: Generator need not run at inference.
